03bbc313:  .;
 .;This routine prompts the user for parameters to generate the
 .;Medical Care Cost Recovery Report.
 .;
 .;The parameters include:
 .;1. Sort output by (PATIENT, PHY, or SERVICE)
 .;2. Print report for (INPATIENT, OUTPATIENT, or BOTH)
 .;3. Start and end dates for events to be included
 .;4. Whether to include summary deficiencies for inpatients
 .;
 .;The routine sets up variables based on user input and calls
 .;the DGJPDEF1 routine to generate the report.
 .
6d8fce1b: ;Translate user input to numeric codes for sort method
d9e0e62e: ;Set numeric code for sort method based on user input
f6d70133: ;If user enters '?' display help message for sort method
56efb261: ;If invalid input, display help message for sort method
7fa0374b: ;Translate user input to numeric codes for patient type
2b342d9e: ;Set numeric code for patient type based on user input
84d1fcf8: ;If user enters '?' display help message for patient type
9f6ce142: ;If invalid input, display help message for patient type
c831a608: ;Check if multi-divisional reporting is enabled
ad4aecc0: ;Initialize page counter
aae4a9bd: ;Check if multi-divisional reporting is enabled
3e0faafc: ;Set variable for sorting based on user input
bc95ab7b: ;Branch to DGJPDEF1 routine to generate report

2f8c4e0c:  .;
 .;This tag prompts the user for start and end dates
 .;for the events to be included in the report.
 .;
 .;The BEG label prompts for the start date,
 .;the END label prompts for the end date.
 .;Input validation is performed to ensure the end date
 .;is not before the start date.
 .
5dbcf51d: ;Prompt for and validate start date
64cc93e6: ;Prompt for and validate end date
1544425a: ;Store end date plus .9999 to include events on that day
b054b970: ;Check if end date is before start date and display error if so
